answer: Sealed calibration admission: a new identity earns no weight until it grades 30 hidden-answer tasks. Each task carries a crystal, a hash commitment to the true grade, opened only after the identity submits, so grades can't be copied. Five tasks hold a pigment, a planted known-bad answer, and the identity must flag all five. A raven seed from the last block hash and the identity's key picks its 30 tasks, so no two fakes share a set. Each fake pays about 30 judgments (~60,000 tokens) even if never caught; 500 fakes cost 30M.
